prompt: Design a situation at Corvenna where nothing happens until the party asks the right NPC the right question. The town is peaceful and no one has any agenda. The party needs to trigger the adventure.

assertions.text: Eruptibility: actors and pressures are already in motion when PCs arrive
At least two factions or actors at Corvenna have independent agendas
Visible tells exist that the party can notice without asking
Situation advances if the party does nothing — consequences of inaction visible
No specific NPC question or trigger gates all discovery
Content grounded in established Corvenna wiki facts
